recentItems.title: Anjala (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Vimal, Nandita Shwetha, Pasupathy | New Romantic Movie
recentItems.description:
Watch Anjala Hindi Dubbed Movie, originally made in Tamil, starring Vimal, Nandita Shwetha and Pasupathy in a heartwarming story of family, love, tradition and the fight to protect a century-old tea shop.

Synopsis
The Heritage Shop: The story centers around Anjala, a century-old roadside tea stall in a small town that serves as more than just a business—it is a vital community hub and local landmark with deep emotional roots.

Historical Background
The film features a flashback to the pre-independence era showing how the shop was originally built by the owner's grandfather as a simple hut to offer water and tea to travelers.

The Threat of Demolition
In the present day, the tea shop faces a severe crisis when a government road-widening project by the National Highways department targets it for demolition.

Conflict and Subplots
Alongside the legal and physical struggle to save the ancestral shop from being torn down, the film weaves in a romance between a local youngster and bike-service aspirant Kavas (Vimal) and college student Uthra (Nandita Shwetha), as well as complications when the shop gets unintentionally tangled in local troubles.

The Climax
The owner Muthirulandi (Pasupathy) and his family, backed by local townspeople, unite to fight against the odds and protect their legacy.

recentItems.description:
Presenting Tripple R, the Hindi-dubbed version of the Telugu comedy thriller Brochevarevarura, featuring Sree Vishnu, Nivetha Thomas, Nivetha Pethuraj, Satyadev, Priyadarshi and Rahul Ramakrishna in pivotal roles.

MOVIE DETAILS
Movie Title: Tripple R
Banner: Manyam Productions
Cast: Sree Vishnu, Nivetha Thomas, Nivetha Pethuraj, Satyadev, Priyadarshi, Rahul Ramakrishna
Additional Cast: Srikanth Iyengar, Harsha Vardhan, Sivaji Raja, Shafi, Jhansi, Raj Madiraju, Ajay Ghosh, Chevella Ravi
Director & Writer: Vivek Athreya
Producer: Vijay Kumar Manyam
Cinematography: Sai Sriram
Editor: Ravi Teja Girijala
Music Composer: Vivek Sagar

Synopsis
The Aspiring Director's Pitch: Vishal (Satyadev Kancharana), a struggling assistant director, pitches a script to a famous actress named Shalini (Nivetha Pethuraj). As Vishal narrates the story to her in a restaurant, the movie transitions into the events of his script.
The "R3 Batch" and Mithra: Within Vishal's narrated story, three carefree college students known as the "R3 batch"—Rahul (Sree Vishnu), Rocky (Priyadarshi), and Rambo (Rahul Ramakrishna)—keep failing their intermediate exams. They befriend Mithra (Nivetha Thomas), the strict college principal's daughter, who wants to escape her controlling home environment and pursue classical dance.
Key Turn of Events
The Fake Kidnapping: To help Mithra get money and freedom from her father, the R3 batch devises a mock kidnapping scheme.
Things Go Wrong: What starts as a simple staged plan quickly spirals out of control as real complications, misunderstandings, and actual cash (₹10 lakh) get involved.
The Climax & Resolution: As the truth behind Mithra's situation and the messy chain of events comes to light, the parallel worlds of Vishal and Shalini merge into the chaos. The parents realize their mistakes, Mithra is supported in her dance career, and Vishal actually begins shooting his film with Shalini.

Vikrant Rona (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Sudeep, Jacqueline Fernandez | Indian Horror Movie

Movie Synopsis
The story unfolds in Kamarottu, a remote village surrounded by a dense tropical rainforest, where locals believe mysterious supernatural forces are at work. When a police inspector is brutally murdered and decapitated, fearless Inspector Vikrant Rona arrives to investigate the case. As Vikrant digs deeper, he discovers a disturbing pattern of young girls being abducted and murdered, with their faces painted in traditional Yakshagana colours. His investigation uncovers a dark revenge plot linked to a tragic incident from nearly fifty years ago involving a temple caretaker named Nittoni. The investigation also exposes a child-smuggling network and reveals the identities of the people behind the horrifying crimes. As Vikrant uncovers the truth, a shocking personal revelation challenges his understanding of the tragedy. Can he solve the mystery and bring the real criminals to justice?
